**Job Summary**

PT Japfa Comfeed Indonesia Tbk is seeking a dedicated and detail-oriented Purchasing Staff (General) for Region IJA, Area 3. In this role, you will be responsible for procuring general goods and services required for regional operations efficiently, cost-effectively, and in alignment with the company’s procurement policies and standards.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Source, select, and negotiate with vendors to obtain the best price, quality, and delivery terms for general goods and services.
* Process purchase requisitions and issue purchase orders (PO) accurately within the designated system.
* Monitor and follow up on order deliveries to ensure goods and services are received on time and meet the required specifications.
* Maintain strong, professional relationships with suppliers and evaluate vendor performance regularly.
* Coordinate closely with internal departments in Region IJA, Area 3 to understand their procurement needs and resolve any supply discrepancies.
* Maintain accurate procurement records, documentation, and price databases for auditing and reporting purposes.

**Job Qualifications**

* Minimum of a Bachelor’s all Degree
* Male workers
* At least 1–2 years of experience in purchasing, procurement, or supply chain management, preferably within the livestock, agribusiness, or manufacturing industry.
* Strong negotiation, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Proficient in using MS Office (Excel, Word) and experienced with ERP/procurement systems (such as SAP).
* Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to work effectively under tight deadlines.
* Deep knowledge of the local vendor network in Region IJA, Area 3 is highly advantageous.

**Ringkasan Pekerjaan**

PT Japfa Comfeed Indonesia Tbk sedang mencari Staff Purchasing (Umum) yang teliti dan berdedikasi untuk Wilayah IJA, Area 3. Dalam peran ini, kamu akan bertanggung jawab untuk membeli barang dan jasa umum yang dibutuhkan untuk operasi regional dengan efisien, hemat biaya, dan sesuai dengan kebijakan serta standar pengadaan perusahaan.

**Tanggung Jawab Pekerjaan**

Mencari, memilih, dan menegosiasikan dengan vendor untuk mendapatkan harga, kualitas, dan syarat pengiriman terbaik untuk barang dan jasa umum.

* Memproses permintaan pembelian dan mengeluarkan pesanan pembelian (PO) secara akurat dalam sistem yang ditentukan.

* Memantau dan menindaklanjuti pengiriman pesanan untuk memastikan barang dan jasa diterima tepat waktu dan sesuai spesifikasi yang dibutuhkan.

* Menjaga hubungan profesional yang kuat dengan pemasok dan secara rutin mengevaluasi kinerja vendor.

* Berkoordinasi secara dekat dengan departemen internal di Region IJA, Area 3 untuk memahami kebutuhan pengadaan mereka dan menyelesaikan setiap ketidaksesuaian pasokan.

* Menjaga catatan pengadaan, dokumentasi, dan basis data harga yang akurat untuk keperluan audit dan pelaporan.

**Kualifikasi Pekerjaan**

* Minimal gelar Sarjana di semua bidang Jurusan.

* Laki-laki

* Paling sedikit 1–2 tahun pengalaman di bidang pembelian, pengadaan, atau manajemen rantai pasok, sebaiknya di industri peternakan, agribisnis, atau manufaktur.

* Keterampilan negosiasi, komunikasi, dan interpersonal yang kuat.

* Mahir menggunakan MS Office (Excel, Word) dan berpengalaman dengan sistem ERP/pengadaan (seperti SAP).

* Sangat terorganisir, detail, dan mampu bekerja efektif di bawah tenggat waktu yang ketat

.* Pengetahuan mendalam tentang jaringan vendor lokal di Wilayah IJA, Area 3

JAPFA is an agribusiness company that engages mainly in the production of animal feed, poultry breeding, commercial farm, consumer products, aquaculture, and beef cattle farming. Founded in Indonesia and now headquartered in Singapore, we employ over 37,000 people across an integrated network of modern farming, processing and distribution facilities in Indonesia, Vietnam, India, Myanmar, and Bangladesh. We believe our people are the key to staying ahead, and we continuously seek talented individuals to grow with us and contribute to our mission.
